ESLint is part of 3 of my public repositories, from 2016 to 2025.

What it was for: [Libraries](@/projects/libraries.md) (2) and [Tools](@/projects/tools.md) (1).

Most recently: [dispatcher](@/work/dispatcher.md); [peg-parser](@/work/peg-parser.md): Parser built using peg.js; [babel-plugin-transform-graphql](@/work/babel-plugin-transform-graphql.md): Babel Plugin for Transforming GraphQL.

How to read the evidence: every [repository](@/glossary/repository.md) below is measured from GitHub and GitLab (every 6 hours) and says how it uses ESLint: as the main language, as a measured share of its code, in its declared stack or as a topic. The reference graph links ESLint to the repositories and to the other languages and technologies they use together.
